results.content: # Waymo Executive Tells Axios Tesla's Camera-Only Self-Driving Can't See Enough. Waymo VP Srikanth Thirumalai told Axios in an August 26 interview that camera-only self-driving can't see enough to be safe at scale, a pointed rebuttal to Elon Musk's Tesla Vision strategy. *Waymo is using its 200 million fully autonomous miles to make a blunt argument against Tesla's camera-only bet: better AI can't recover detail a car never sensed in the first place.*. In an interview with Axios published August 26, 2026, he made the case against camera-only autonomy in the plainest terms: "the AI can only make sense of what it sees, and if you just can't see it, the AI can't do much.".
